output.review_comment: The month/year-based logic for end date inclusion appears to be test-specific rather than a natural docstring requirement. Please verify: (1) that the full docstring actually specifies this month/year behavior, (2) the rationale for this unusual logic, and (3) that tests genuinely exercise this as a documented requirement rather than an implementation detail.
